create_blob_triangulation_node: create a BlobTriangulationNode instance with prop names, camera extrinsics, intrinsics, and position limits
run_blob_triangulation_spin: run the BlobTriangulationNode spin loop to continuously triangulate blob centers from multiple cameras
fuse_blob_centers: fuse detected 2D blob center points from multiple cameras into 3D poses using linear triangulation
close_blob_triangulation_node: close the BlobTriangulationNode and cleanly shut down all ROS topic subscribers and publishers
get_powerset_combinations: get all combinations of camera subsets with a minimum cardinality for triangulation attempts
